text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "the kubelet waits 5 seconds",
      "claim_text": "In the exec example, the kubelet waits 5 seconds before the first probe.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "initialDelaySeconds is 5 seconds."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "runs cat /tmp/healthy every 5 seconds",
      "claim_text": "In the exec example, the kubelet runs cat /tmp/healthy every 5 seconds.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P0.S3", "rel": "entails"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "periodSeconds 5 and command cat /tmp/healthy."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the file exists only for the first 30 seconds",
      "claim_text": "The /tmp/healthy file exists only for the first 30 seconds of the container's life.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states file exists for first 30 seconds."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "after that the probe fails",
      "claim_text": "After 30 seconds, the exec probe fails.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "After 30 seconds cat returns failure code."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the container is killed and restarted",
      "claim_text": "When the exec probe fails, the kubelet kills and restarts the container.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S5", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Non-zero return leads to kill and restart."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the first probe runs 3 seconds after the container starts",
      "claim_text": "In the HTTP example, the first probe runs 3 seconds after the container starts.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "initialDelaySeconds is 3 seconds."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "repeats every 3 seconds",
      "claim_text": "In the HTTP example, the probe repeats every 3 seconds.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "periodSeconds is 3 seconds."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "/healthz returns 200 only for the first 10 seconds",
      "claim_text": "The /healthz handler returns 200 only for the first 10 seconds the container is alive.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states 200 for first 10 seconds."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the first couple of checks succeed",
      "claim_text": "The first couple of HTTP health checks succeed.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states first couple checks succeed."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "before the kubelet restarts the container",
      "claim_text": "After 10 seconds, the HTTP health checks fail and the kubelet kills and restarts the container.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states after 10 seconds checks fail and container killed/restarted."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "A startup probe with failureThreshold 30 and periodSeconds 10",
      "claim_text": "A startup probe with failureThreshold 30 and periodSeconds 10 is configured.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage mentions 30 * 10 = 300s."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "gives an application at most 300 seconds, or five minutes, to start",
      "claim_text": "The startup probe gives the application at most 300 seconds (five minutes) to finish startup.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "30 * 10", "op": "==", "value": "300"},
      "reasoning": "30*10=300 seconds, which is 5 minutes."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "once it has succeeded once the liveness probe takes over",
      "claim_text": "Once the startup probe has succeeded once, the liveness probe takes over.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states liveness takes over after startup succeeds."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the first liveness probe runs 15 seconds after the container starts",
      "claim_text": "In the TCP example, the first liveness probe runs 15 seconds after the container starts.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states first liveness probe 15 seconds after start."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "repeats every 10 seconds",
      "claim_text": "In the TCP example, the liveness probe repeats every 10 seconds.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S5", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states check every 10 seconds."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the third liveness check happens about 35 seconds after start",
      "claim_text": "The third liveness check in the TCP example happens about 35 seconds after container start.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P7.S2", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P7.S5", "rel": "entails"}
      ],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "15 + 2 * 10", "op": "==", "value": "35"},
      "reasoning": "First at 15s, then every 10s: third at 15+20=35s."
    }
  ]
}
